decision: Selected the centroid of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcel 224-58-003 (situs 1160 WALSH AV, SANTA CLARA 95050-2647), the parcel at the address NTT DATA publishes for SV1, as the site locator. It locates the parcel, not the SV1 building outline.
layer: County of Santa Clara Parcels (Socrata dataset ubcd-cewv on data.sccgov.org), GeoJSON in WGS84; rows carry APN, situs address and jurisdiction only (no owner fields)

computed.method: Parcel polygon from the county dataset; centroid computed in EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N) and returned to WGS84; EPSG:5070 and EPSG:3310 cross-checks give the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: NTT DATA's Silicon Valley SV1 page (version of 22 October 2026, captured 7 November 2026) and the Internet Archive copy of 20 April 2026 of its predecessor give '1160 Walsh Ave., Santa Clara, CA 95050'.
A query of the county Parcels dataset for situs house number 1160 on WALSH in SANTA CLARA returns exactly one parcel, 22458003 (two situs addresses).
